test_get_traceable_model: test get_traceable_model to verify a PyTorch model with control flow submodules can be correctly traced
run_jit_trace_with_scripted_submodules: run torch.jit.trace on a model after calling get_traceable_model to handle control flow in submodules
create_nn_module_with_to_traceable: create an nn.Module subclass that implements to_traceable to script submodules before tracing the parent
refactor_model_for_jit_tracing: refactor a PyTorch model by adding to_traceable methods so get_traceable_model can script control-flow submodules
review_submodule_control_flow_tracing: review a SubModule with conditional forward logic to ensure torch.jit.script handles branching correctly
